title: Autism mutations rewire protein interaction networks to drive neurodevelopmental pathology.
authors: Wang, Belinda; Vartak, Rasika; Hennick, Kelsey M; Zaltsman, Yefim; Naing, Zun Zar Chi; Polacco, Benjamin J; Bashir, Ali; Eckhardt, Manon; Bouhaddou, Mehdi; Xu, Jiewei; Sun, Nawei; Lasser, Micaela C; Zhou, Yuan; McKetney, Justin; Guiley, Keelan Z; Gniewek, Pawel; Chan, Una; Amirani, Naufa; Griffiths, Owen; Chadha, Nishant; Tognatta, Reshmi; Cakir, Merve; Gordon, Martin; Khare, Prachi; Drake, Sam; Drury, Vanessa; Burke, David F; Gonzalez, Silvano; Alkhairy, Sahar; Thomas, Reuben; Lam, Stephanie; Morris, Montana; Bader, Ethel; Dos Santos, Melanie; Komarova, Anastassia V; Bennett, Maxwell; Ennis, Craig; Castillo, Octavio; Lim, Yvonne; Martin, Robert; Seyler, Meghan; Baum, Tierney; Krasnoff, Rebecca; Wang, George; Middya, Sagnik; Wang, Sheng; Pham, Presley; Arbelaez, Juan; Pratt, Dexter; Bali, Sofia; Chag, Shivali; Kaye, Julia A; Mahmood, Nadir; Spraggon, Lee; Rolland, Thomas; Hervey-Jumper, Shawn; Fraser, James S; Bourgeron, Thomas; Finkbeiner, Steven; Demeret, Caroline; Swaney, Danielle L; Bandyopadhyay, Sourav; Ideker, Trey; Beltrao, Pedro; Willsey, Helen Rankin; Huttenhain, Ruth; Obernier, Kirsten; Nowakowski, Tomasz J; State, Matthew W; Willsey, A Jeremy; Krogan, Nevan J
one_liner_zh: 该文通过质谱和AlphaFold系统绘制自闭症相关蛋白互作网络，虽涉及FOXP1转录因子，但核心是蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白-DNA结合，且无AI/物理模拟方法用于TF-DNA互作建模，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: Systematic mapping of protein-protein interaction (PPI) networks and determining how causal mutations rewire them in autism spectrum disorder (ASD) provide a powerful framework for uncovering disease mechanisms and therapeutic opportunities. Using affinity purification-mass spectrometry, we systematically mapped PPIs for 100 high-confidence ASD genes, uncovering more than 1800 interactions. By assessing the impact of pathogenic missense mutations, leveraging AlphaFold, and validating key findings in human-derived model systems, we identified marked convergence onto shared protein complexes in the wild-type state and convergent PPI rewiring driven by independent mutations. For example, distinct patient-derived variants in FOXP1 disrupt its interactions with FOXP4, leading to changes in cortical neurogenesis and neural activity in brain organoids. Overall, these findings link genetic variation to protein networks and convergent neurodevelopmental dysfunction in ASD.
abstract_zh: 系统性地绘制蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络，并确定自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）中因果突变如何重塑这些网络，为揭示疾病机制和治疗机会提供了一个强有力的框架。利用亲和纯化-质谱法，我们系统性地绘制了100个高置信度ASD基因的PPIs，发现了超过1800种相互作用。通过评估致病性错义突变的影响、利用AlphaFold，并在人源衍生模型系统中验证关键发现，我们识别出在野生型状态下对共享蛋白复合物的显著趋同，以及由独立突变驱动的趋同性PPI重塑。例如，FOXP1中不同的患者来源变异破坏其与FOXP4的相互作用，导致脑类器官中皮层神经发生和神经活动的变化。总体而言，这些发现将遗传变异与蛋白质网络及ASD中的趋同性神经发育功能障碍联系起来。
